sloka: त्वरया चानयामास पश्चात्तौ श्रोष्यतः प्रियम् ।तान्वेश्मनानाभरणैर्यथार्हं प्रतिपूजितान् ॥२-१-४७॥
transliteration: tvarayā cānayāmāsa paścāttau śroṣyataḥ priyam ।tānveśmanānābharaṇairyathārhaṁ pratipūjitān ॥2-1-47॥

translations.english: The king who received them in a befitting manner and provided them with residence and ornaments looked like lord Brahma adorned by the people.
